# Chaotic Good Guild

> The Chaotic Good Guild: a village for dreamers, misfits and kind rebels. Tarot readings, the Guild calendar, fables, community and more.

The Chaotic Good Guild is a creative universe about living Chaotic Good: kind, free-spirited and playfully rebellious, in contrast to the Lawful Evil Overlords (LEOs). Its characters include Reynard the fox, Mira the witchy cat, the Badger, the Bull, the rats of the Guild, the LEO Lion and the Corporate Wolf.

## Rooms

- [The Chaotic Good Spread](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/tarot/): Cross the candlelight and cut the cards. Mira reads what the mirrors murmur and what the stars are willing to spill.
- [The Guild Calendar](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/calendar/): Stay attuned to the phases of the moon, the shifting sands of season, and the fables of the fate of foxes.
- [The Notice Board](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/notice-board/): Quills scratch and whispers wander. Pin your plans, pass your notes, and find the friends your fortune favors.
- [The Guild Hall](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/guild-hall/): Knock thrice and name yourself. The Hall keeps a hearth, a ledger, and a place for every kind of rebel.
- [Reynard's Stump](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/stories/): Lend an ear to the lute. The fox has fables to tell, and a few of them are even true.
- [The Galleon Market](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/market/): Honest goods for honest galleons. Trade fair, tread kindly, and take a little of the Guild home.
- [The Raising](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/about/): Beam by beam and day by day, the Bull builds what the village dreams. Ask him what it is all for.
- [The City on the Hill](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/alignment-test/): Dare to look toward the red towers. Learn where your heart lands between law and chaos, kindness and coin.

## Essays

- [Chaotic Good Vessel](https://www.chaoticgoodguild.com/stories/chaotic-good-vessel/): Why are we doing this? Why bring back a fox from the old fables? Because the fox is just a vessel. It's the Chaotic Good ideas that bring us together.
